snippet.title: PAPERENTS- Horror Game Official Launch Trailer| OUT NOW on itch.io #horrorgame #retro
snippet.description:
We are making a whole series of childhood horror stories, Peekaboo Tales. 
Our first horror game PAPERENTS is available now on：https://hell0-dirtty-games.itch.io/paperents

The brief story: 
After moving into their new home, 10-year-old Liam begins to sense an unsettling presence lurking in the dark corners of his room. Strange noises echo through the house, and his parents grow increasingly bizarre and terrifying.  
Paralyzed and confined to his bed, Liam finds himself trapped in a room filled with unspeakable horrors, slowly sinking into endless desperation.

We're still improving the game. Please share your feedback/bug report here, @Hell0 Dirtty Games-X/Discord/Itch.io
Players like you make horror better. Thank you for playing!
